params.1274: Acquire a herring by fishing or by buying it.
params.1275: To fish for herring, use a rod and bait at a saltwater bait fishing spot with at least 10 Fishing.
params.1276: Use your raw herring on a range or fire with at least 5 Cooking.
params.1277: It is possible to burn your herring by mistake, so you may wish to bring several.
